title: Ground beef rice bowls with Japanese BBQ sauce and roasted broccoli
equipment: Large skillet + sheet pan + rice cooker
ingredients: Kinder's Buttery Steakhouse or salt and pepper
Japanese BBQ sauce, for drizzling (sugary, so go light)

steps.do: Start the rice cooker and heat the oven to 425°F.
Spread the frozen broccoli on a sheet pan (no need to thaw), toss with oil, salt and pepper, and roast 20 to 25 min until browned at the edges.
Meanwhile brown the beef in 2 batches, breaking it up, and season with Kinder's.
Build bowls with rice, beef and broccoli; drizzle lightly with Japanese BBQ sauce.

changes: Your beef rice bowl favorite, with your frozen broccoli instead of Costco sheet pan veggies.
